reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: Since the last update you cannot complete tasks from the widget anymore they do not update unless you open the app and close them out there

reviews.title: Ugh
reviews.text: Do not expect to be able to restore purchases on multiple accounts. I love this program. However, what turned into a one time purchase on one account means it’s LOCKED to that account. So that means even if you have one email associated with the app, if you use different accounts on your iPad and iPhone you have to pay for the upgrade on both. I think this is a little bit of a bait and switch situation. I use the same account on BOTH devices for the APP….but I’m not willing to pay twice to remove the ads. Time to find a different program…which sucks because this one works so well for me.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Not sure why this has high reviews.  It wouldn’t let me do anything. Can’t delete or edit some things that I mis-typed.  And when I try to make new categories, it just closes my keyboard and won’t let me type.  Don’t waste your time.
